gloss: the side next to; the neighboring side; adjacent side

definitions.gloss: the side next to; the neighboring side; adjacent side
definitions.explanation: The side or area immediately next to something or someone. Used when specifying which side of an object, building, or space you are referring to.

examples.japanese: {隣側|となりがわ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{席|せき}→席：02215_seki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{空|あ}いている→空く：11062_aku⟧。
examples.english: The seat on the adjacent side is empty.

examples.japanese: ⟦{壁|かべ}→壁：01290_kabe⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{隣側|となりがわ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{音楽|おんがく}→音楽：00661_ongaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{聞|き}こえて→聞こえる：01229_kikoeru⟧くる。
examples.english: I can hear music from the other side of the wall.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{隣側|となりがわ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦カフェ→カフェ：06767_kafe⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦オープン→オープン：10831_oopun⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧だ。
examples.english: A new café is scheduled to open on the side next to this building.

notes:
Formed from ⟦{隣|となり}→隣：01003_tonari⟧ (next to, adjacent) and ⟦{側|がわ}→〜側：03090_gawa⟧ (side). Used to specify position relative to something. The ⟦{側|がわ}→〜側：03090_gawa⟧ suffix is productive and attaches to many spatial words.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {隣側|となりがわ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧: the room on the adjacent side
- {隣側|となりがわ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{座|すわ}る→座る：00757_suwaru⟧: to sit on the neighboring side
- {隣側|となりがわ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧: from the neighboring side

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{向|む}こう{側|がわ}→向こう側：08504_mukougawa⟧: the other side, opposite side — across from the speaker, not adjacent
- ⟦{下側|したがわ}→下側：26573_shitagawa⟧: lower side — same ⟦{側|がわ}→〜側：03090_gawa⟧ pattern with a vertical direction
- ⟦{隣|となり}→隣：01003_tonari⟧: next to — the base word without the ⟦{側|がわ}→〜側：03090_gawa⟧ specification
